request_timeout_ms.doc: Inbound HTTP request timeout in milliseconds

deploy_tier.doc: Deployment tier label surfaced to the running service

health_check_path.doc: HTTP path the platform probes for liveness

environment.doc: Deployment target. prod tightens the request timeout and flips the tier label.

log_level.doc: Log verbosity. debug is disallowed in prod (see the prod_forbids_debug constraint).

replica_class.doc: Sizing selection recorded for the environment; consumed downstream to pick a replica count.

beta_dashboard.doc: Feature toggle for the beta dashboard UI, recorded per environment.

prod_forbids_debug.doc: Debug logging is not permitted in production.
